name: Chiffon Grace (シフォン グレイス)
reasoning: I tried to disprove this by hunting for wheat products in the lineup, a wheat-handling kitchen, or any 'glutened' report, and found none: the shop's own Instagram bio carries a shop-wide claim 「グルテンフリー、小麦粉は使用していません」 (stronger than the record's 'batter only' caveat), and four independent Japanese sources — Hokuriku Chunichi Shimbun (which interviewed the owner and reports the GF cakes are popular with pregnant and allergy customers), asap.blog ('すべてが米粉で作られるグルテンフリーのシフォンケーキ'), weekend-kanazawa and ishikawa-style — all describe a rice-flour-only lineup with no wheat item sold. What I could NOT find is any celiac-grade source, any allergen label, or any cross-contact statement, so this clears `high` but is nowhere near `dedicated`. Identity, address (能美市寺井町ウ7-1, in front of Terai Budokan), Sept 27 2025 opening and Tue/Sat-only hours all check out.
red_flags: No celiac-grade source anywhere (no FindMeGlutenFree/HappyCow/GF-Japan listing) — all evidence is Japanese local media echoing the shop
No allergen labelling or cross-contact statement published; small home-scale operation
Open only Tuesday and Saturday, 11:00 until sold out — sells out quickly, so a trip can easily be wasted
ishikawa-style article does not itself use 小麦粉不使用; it only frames the shop as a gluten-free-friendly option
plain_rice: No — takeout chiffon-cake shop only, no rice dishes served.
identity_note: Identity confirmed. One correction to the record: the wheat-free claim is NOT batter-scoped — the shop's own Instagram states 小麦粉は使用していません for the shop. The record's flavour list (orange sandwich with rice-flour cookies) was not reproduced in the sources I could reach; the confirmed lineup is plain, Noto-salt vanilla, Earl Grey, banana-cranberry, coffee choc-chip plus chiffon fruit sandwiches.

name: Comecobito (こめこびと／椿原製菓)
reasoning: I tried to find the second independent source that `high` requires and failed. The shop's own Instagram bio says only 「玄米粉シフォンとヴィーガン米粉マフィンのお店」 — it makes NO gluten-free or 小麦不使用 claim, no allergen statement and no cross-contact note — so the record's 「小麦粉や乳製品不使用で、安心の無添加」 wording traces to exactly one source, the weekend-kanazawa blog post. Instagram is first-party, not independent, so this is a single-source label and the protocol's HARD RULE caps it at options/ask. No celiac-grade listing, no negative report, and no evidence of wheat production either — the finding is simply an absence of corroboration.
red_flags: Single independent source — HARD RULE violation for `high`
Shop's own Instagram bio makes no gluten-free / 小麦不使用 claim at all; the GF framing exists only in a third-party blog
No allergen statement, no cross-contact policy, no celiac-grade corroboration found

Record described it as 'run by Tsubakihara Confectionery', implying an established confectioner; the founder is in fact an ex-Chinese-restaurant chef named Tsubakihara trading as 椿原製菓 — so there is no track record of allergen practice to lean on
plain_rice: No — takeout chiffon/muffin stand, no rice dishes served.
identity_note: Identity confirmed: Instagram account name is 「Comecobito（こめこびと）-椿原製菓-（津幡町）」, 石川県河北郡津幡町南中条ニ163-5, open Wed/Fri/Sun 11:00–17:00. The record carries no hours; also note its 加賀棒茶 'FLAG RESOLVED' claim could not be re-verified from any source I reached.

name: My Chiffon (マイシフォン)
reasoning: I tried to confirm a whole-shop wheat-free position and instead found the opposite of what the tier needs: the shop's own Instagram bio says only 「お米シフォンケーキ専門店」 with no gluten-free or 小麦粉不使用 claim, and the weekend-kanazawa article scopes 「小麦粉や乳製品、卵不使用」 to the 焼き菓子 specifically, not to the chiffon cakes or to the premises. Both remaining sources are local Kanazawa food blogs relaying the same shop-supplied information, and no celiac-grade source exists. The shop also sells granola built on oats — Japanese oats are almost never GF-certified and are routinely milled on wheat/barley lines, so there is a plausible gluten vector physically inside this small kitchen.
red_flags: No first-party gluten-free or wheat-free claim — Instagram bio says only 'rice chiffon cake specialist'
The 小麦粉不使用 wording is scoped to the baked goods (焼き菓子) only; the article explicitly does not describe the whole shop as wheat-free
Oat granola sold on the premises — uncertified oats are a standard wheat cross-contact vector in Japan and the sourcing is undocumented
Both sources are local promo-style blogs echoing the shop; no celiac-grade corroboration found
Chiffon cakes contain eggs (not vegan) — the record's vegan_status 'options' rests on the baked goods only
plain_rice: No — takeout cake shop, no rice dishes served.
identity_note: Identity confirmed: 石川県金沢市京町23-8, behind 城北病院, opened 23 Oct (2024), takeout only, irregular days (closed Mon/Tue/Thu/Sun, irregular Sat), owner 岡田葉月, Instagram @mychiffon_kome. Instagram shows an August closure reopening 2 Sept — seasonal, not a permanent closure.

name: Koma Gallery Cafe
reasoning: I tried to break this by testing whether the GF story is an aggregator artifact with no Japanese-side backing, and it survived: the Japanese identity is 高麗ギャラリーカフェ (京都市東山区金園町397, below the Yasaka Pagoda), its Retty menu shows every food item labelled グルテンフリー on a 米粉パン base — GF ham/egg sandwiches, GF an-butter toast, GF matcha roll cake, matcha-butter dorayaki — with no wheat item on the menu, and the operator's sister site (高麗屋 / NPO KOMA, Sendai) states 「グルテンフリーのスイーツとパンをご提供させて頂いております。小麦粉を一切使用せず、又、食用グルテンも一切追加しておりません」 while naming the Kyoto Koma Gallery Cafe as also serving GF sweets. Independent corroboration: How To Coeliac (a coeliac blogger who personally ate the dorayaki there), FindMeGlutenFree (listed dedicated GF; a reviewer reports a celiac spouse eating there four times without being glutened) and Atly (100% dedicated GF). I found no glutening report, no closure and no wheat item — but the shop's own English site has an expired SSL certificate and the main domain is now an artist portal, so the first-party claim is only reachable second-hand. Stays at high, not dedicated.
red_flags: DATA INTEGRITY: the record's evidence block attributes to how-to-coeliac the line 'Everything on the menu is gluten-free... rather than just a handful of items'. The live page does not say that — its entry reads 'known for its gluten-free cakes and Japanese sweets' and tags 'Other Dietary Requirements: unsure'. The quote appears to have been embellished by an earlier pass and should be corrected on the record.
First-party GF claim is not directly reachable: komagallerycafe.com is now the いだきしん／高麗恵子 artist portal and english.komagallerycafe.com has an EXPIRED SSL certificate
The strongest 小麦粉を一切使用せず wording comes from the operator's Sendai sister cafe (高麗屋), not from the Kyoto premises itself
Japanese-language GF coverage is thin — the cafe does not appear in Japanese gluten-free roundups for Kyoto, and Tabelog omits GF entirely
Address inconsistency across aggregators: 金園町397 (own Instagram) vs 401 (gluten-free-japan) vs 393 (Atly)
Operated by an art/music organisation (いだきしん・高麗恵子 portal), so food-allergen practice is not its core competency
plain_rice: Not confirmed — the menu is rice-flour bread, sandwiches, dorayaki and cakes; plain unseasoned gohan is not an advertised item. Do not count on it as a rice fallback.
identity_note: Identity resolves to 高麗ギャラリーカフェ, 京都市東山区金園町397, beneath the Yasaka Pagoda in Higashiyama, 10:00–19:00, closed Tuesdays — NOT Gion/Shijo as some English sources describe. The record's neighborhood field is empty ('—') and its website field is null; both should be filled with 東山区金園町 and https://www.instagram.com/komagallerycafe/ (the .com domain is an artist portal, not a cafe site).

name: プレマルシェ・ジェラテリア 三条本店 (Premarché Gelateria Kyoto Sanjo (Honten))
reasoning: The gelato ingredients survive scrutiny — the shop's own site states 「当店のジェラートにはグルテンを含有する素材は一切使用していませんので、安心してお召し上がりください」 and it publishes a per-flavour allergen table — but the same page confirms the disconfirming fact I was hunting for: the cornets sold and handled at that counter are made with wheat flour, with the rice-mochi waffle cup (+¥100) offered as the alternative. So wheat is physically present and handled at the point of service, and NO source — first-party, vegewel, kaiten-portal or any other — describes a single word of cross-contact control (separate spades, gloves, wells), and no celiac-grade review of this shop exists anywhere I could reach. The shop's 'eat with confidence' reassurance is scoped to ingredients only, which is exactly the ingredient-vs-prep gap the `options` tier exists for; on the asymmetric-cost rule this cannot hold `high`.
red_flags: Wheat-flour cornets are sold and handled at the same service counter — confirmed by the shop's own site
Zero documented cross-contamination handling (shared spades, shared water wells, staff handling cornets then serving) in any source

No celiac-grade source exists for this shop — the two independent sources (vegewel, kaiten-portal) document the existence of the GF mochi cup, i.e. a wheat-ALLERGY accommodation, not celiac-grade prep
The GF mochi cup is a paid add-on (+¥100) that must be requested — a guest who does not know to ask gets a wheat cornet or a paper cup
The gelato allergen detail sits behind an external spreadsheet link, so per-flavour wheat status cannot be verified on-page
Record's cuisine_type is 'yoshoku' for a gelato shop — mis-tagged
plain_rice: No — gelato-only shop. The only rice item is the organic mochi/brown-rice waffle cup served as a vessel.
identity_note: Identity confirmed and shop is open: 京都市中京区三条通猪熊西入御供町308, on the Sanjo-kai shopping street, TEL 075-600-2846, Mon/Tue/Thu 12:00–18:00, Fri–Sun/holidays 12:00–20:00, closed Wednesdays. Note there is a SECOND nearby Kyoto branch (京都堀川三条店, an 'Alternative Diner' format) plus 東京中目黒駅前店 — do not confuse the honten with the Horikawa-Sanjo branch, whose menu and wheat handling were not audited here.
